fact: The CSGR-IA, the Gabonese scientific committee on AI research, told the CESEC of its work developing Obone AI, described as the first Gabonese AI system able to process and answer in the Fang language; no release is stated.
ST Digital's CTO Jean-Francis Ahanda says the Nkok data centre in Gabon 'will also host' computing capacity for sovereign AI, with no GPUs or date given.
